name: app-autonomous-ride-tracking-screen-with-floating-chips
title: Ride-progress screen with dark road photo, stat panel and floating chips
whatItIs: A white stage with a phone centre: a dark monochrome road photo with a car from behind and 'Heading to TechHub' in white with lime accent; a white bottom sheet with arrival time and route; a black stat block with lime numbers for charge, speed and distance. Two black chips float outside: a lime-bar ride comfort meter and a trip summary with Premium tag.
whatItMeans: Sleek and reassuring; lime numerals on black communicate precision and control.
techniques: Use a monochrome photo header with a single lime word.
Put stats in a black rounded block with lime numerals.
Float small feature chips beside the phone to explain details.
Use segmented lime bars as a comfort meter.

vocabulary.definition: A bar divided into small lit segments.
A small UI card placed outside the device.
A dark container with several figures.
A greyscale photo at the top of a screen.
